name: HappyFenceNG Total Enterprise Security
author: HappyWPress

sections.description:
HappyFenceNG is the complete security transformation of your WordPress site.
Built with enterprise architecture and advanced threat intelligence, it provides top protection through a sophisticated tiered system.

FREE TIER
All you need for a basic security.

PROFESSIONAL TIER
Advanced REST API protection, login security enhancements, and professional-grade hardening features.
Perfect for small businesses and bloggers who want enterprise-level security without enterprise pricing.

AGENCY TIER
Everything in Professional PLUS automated threat detection, filesystem monitoring, and security automation.
Designed for agencies managing multiple sites with white-label options and comprehensive protection.

ENTERPRISE TIER
Complete security fortress with real-time threat intelligence, automated malware removal, and unlimited site protection.
TOP security for mission-critical websites with dedicated priority support.

Core Security Features:
– Advanced REST API protection and endpoint blocking
– Intelligent XML-RPC and pingback controls
– Professional login security with rate limiting
– Automated filesystem scanning and threat detection
– Real-time malware detection and removal
– Advanced metadata protection and author enumeration blocking
– Intelligent robots.txt management
– Enterprise-grade embed and oEmbed controls
– Sophisticated licensing with Freemius integration
– Cloudflare / Reverse proxy filtering/integration
– Geoip integration with external providers

Enterprise Architecture:
Built with modular, scalable architecture featuring distributed licensing checks, ghost method security, and advanced threat intelligence.
Each component is engineered for maximum performance and security.

IMPORTANT NOTES

HappyFenceNG is a WordPress security plugin with enterprise-grade features.
Our mission is to keep your WordPress site safe and secure.
Neither HappyWPress nor Razorvue collect, read, or store any user data.
When an endpoint is provided (e.g., SIEM integration or GeoIP integration), it refers exclusively to external software or services owned or licensed by the end user.
Razorvue and its brands have no connection with these endpoints.
We do not transmit any data to any external endpoint unless explicitly enabled by the user in the admin page, and only for the necessary data.
All features and their purposes are clearly explained in the menu page.
If something is unclear, we strongly recommend not activating the option and contacting us for clarification.
There is no “call home”, “external callback”, hidden feature, or hidden code — the full source code is transparent and can be reviewed line by line.
To avoid any misunderstanding, features requiring external integration (SIEM, GeoIP) are available only in premium editions,
where we provide direct premium support as stated in the license.

Special Notes

This plugin includes internal signature verification for plugin integrity.
All signature checks are local and non-obfuscated.
sections.installation:
– Upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/happyfenceng-total-enterprise-security/
– Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress
– Go to HappyFenceNG in your admin menu to configure security tiers
sections.faq:
What makes HappyFenceNG different from other security plugins?

HappyFenceNG is built with enterprise architecture featuring tiered licensing, advanced threat intelligence, and TOP security features.
It’s designed for professional users who need bulletproof protection.

Can I use this with other security plugins?

While HappyFenceNG focuses on hardening and structural protections, some features like login rate limiting may conflict with similar functionality in other security plugins.
We recommend testing in a staging environment and disabling duplicate features in other plugins for optimal performance.

What’s included in the free version?

The free version includes basic XML-RPC blocking, metadata protection, and embed controls. Professional features require upgrade.

How does the tiered licensing work?

Features are unlocked based on your tier: Free → Professional → Agency → Enterprise 360.
Each tier includes all previous features plus advanced capabilities.

Does it work with multisite?

Currently designed for single-site installations.

Do I need special permission?

This plugin needs to create its own tables so if your database installation does not permit new table creation the plugin will never work.
In order to fix the problem check your database permission and be sure that creating tables in the wp database is allowed at db level/user.

As best practice we always recomend to have a dev environment where to check the ugrades before committing into production. This will save you a lot of headcache in case something goes wrong.
